glosses: shortcut, cutoff (a path between two points that is faster than the commonly used paths)
shortcut (a method to accomplish something that omits one or more steps)
shortcut (a file that points to the location of another file and serves as a quick way to access it)

examples.text: O caminho para o sucesso não conhece atalhos.
examples.en: There is no shortcut to success.

examples.text: Tom fez um atalho para casa.
examples.en: Tom made a beeline for home.
